title: Nvidia 即将完成对 Hugging Face 的收购
content: 据报道，英伟达已同意以 129 亿美元收购流行的开源人工智能中心 Hugging Face，此举将使英伟达既能保护其芯片帝国，又能重返云业务。
original_title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
original_content: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.
